description: This file defines a PHP class 'CallToAction' within the Goteo project, representing a model for 'call to action' items in a web application. It includes properties, methods for database retrieval ('get', 'getList'), saving ('save'), validation ('validate'), and some static configurations.

classes.name: CallToAction
classes.description: Model class representing 'call to action' entries, with properties for various labels and URLs, and methods for retrieving, saving, and validating such objects.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the list of language-specific fields used in localization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a CallToAction object from the database by its ID, considering current language context.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CallToAction objects based on filters, pagination, and language; can return count or data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the current CallToAction object to the database after validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks that the object has necessary data before saving, e.g., ensuring 'title' is not empty.
